[EVENT] User rearranged their spice cabinet last Sunday and is looking for tips on organizing spices.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for organizing spices in a kitchen cabinet provided, including categorizing spices, using tiered racks, storing in airtight containers, labeling, and keeping frequently used spices accessible.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested using a spice carousel or turntable for easy access to spices.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended cleaning and purging spices regularly and storing them away from heat and light.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommendations for non-stick frying pans provided, including T-fal Easy Care, Calphalon Select, All-Clad, Anolon Advanced, Le Creuset, and Mauviel M'heritage.
